details: US military forces have launched significant air attacks on Iran's southern provinces, marking a serious escalation and testing a fragile ceasefire agreed upon weeks prior. This development follows recent attacks on tankers in the Strait of Hormuz, a crucial chokepoint for global energy supplies. The renewed conflict has led to a surge in oil prices, with Brent crude rising above $76 a barrel, fueling inflation concerns and increasing volatility across global financial markets.
title: US Strikes Iran, Oil Soars Amid Hormuz Tensions

details: The Chairman of the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC), Paul Atkins, has unveiled the 2026 regulatory agenda, which includes a priority on crypto market oversight. This move aims to support President Trump's objective of establishing the U.S. as the "Crypto Capital of the World." The agenda focuses on advancing compliance for crypto products, creating rules for crypto asset financing, and defining frameworks for the custody and on-chain trading of tokenized securities.
title: SEC Outlines 2026 Crypto Agenda, Backs "Crypto Capital" Goal
